verdict.rationale: Kit publishes a comprehensive documented public API (v4) with OAuth 2.0/API key auth, pagination, bulk/async processing, webhooks with signature verification, and detailed endpoint references (broadcasts, stats, custom fields, accounts), explicitly aimed at third-party developers building apps for the Kit App Store. This exceeds basic API access, satisfying the ai-native/agenticness axis fully. Missing for 10: no discoverable OpenAPI/Swagger spec file (404s on standard paths), so machine-readable schema discovery is less automatable despite the llms.txt and MCP docs partially compensating.
